trace.command: export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; which noacg; noacg --version; echo "---"; mkdir -p ~/.pki/nssdb && (certutil -d sql:$HOME/.pki/nssdb -N --empty-password 2>/dev/null; for c in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/*.crt; do certutil -d sql:$HOME/.pki/nssdb -A -t C,, -n "$(basename "$c")" -i "$c"; done); echo "certutil exit: $?"; echo "---"; noacg doctor; echo "doctor exit: $?"

export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; noacg scaffold --type scoreboard --design neutral --name "Packages check" --out /workspace/graphic; echo "scaffold exit: $?"; echo "---"; noacg validate /workspace/graphic --screenshots /mnt/session/outputs/shots; echo "validate exit: $?"; echo "---"; ls -la /mnt/session/outputs/shots 2>&1
